requires.purpose: decides every governance and membership change Identity does not reserve to the person, and says who qualifies to approve; the host adapts it to Identity's access-decision and approval-policy ports, so there is no package dependency
the subject of every change is an AuthenticatedPrincipal whose principalId is the identity identifier; the host passes it in
styles the default pages and components; without it they render unstyled but fully functional

providesPorts.consumer: Authorisation (as AuthorisationDirectory, through the host's adapter)

integration.consumers: consume the contract and the provided ports through host adapters; never read the identity schema
integration.composition: host supplies ports from a Nitro plugin; persistence follows ADR-0002; Identity holds no personal data (ADR-0005)
